name: upload
description: An upward arrow rising above an open sending tray.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: The arrow is centered at x=12 above a straight-sided U tray. The tray has a horizontal base and open top, preserving the recognizable receiving/sending object instead of a surrounding frame. Total centerline bounds x=4..20/y=3.5..20.5 balance visible padding 3.15 horizontally and 2.65 vertically. The 1.70 stroke supplies consistent rounded tray joints and free ends. Native X/Y=100%, rotation=0 and Regular 1.70 are the reference. Round 4 draft awaiting owner review. Owner rejected the radius-1.50 curved-head experiment on2026-10-27. Return to the original straight-arm V head with round .85 caps and round stroke joins at Regular1.70. Do not reintroduce a broad centerline fillet. Both styles remain drafts awaiting owner review.
